title: AI for Science
question: How can scientific knowledge, observations, and simulation help uncover mechanisms in complex systems?
summary: We combine machine learning with scientific knowledge and simulation to discover the mechanisms behind complex systems.
description: We combine machine learning with scientific knowledge and simulation to discover the mechanisms behind complex systems.

title: Continuous-Time Modeling
question: How can we learn, forecast, and simulate continuous dynamics from irregular observations?
summary: We model continuous dynamics from irregular observations with neural differential equations and account for stability and uncertainty.
description: We model continuous dynamics from irregular observations with neural differential equations and account for stability and uncertainty.

title: Evidence-Centered AI
question: What comparisons and uncertainty assessments justify an AI claim?
summary: We develop principles for judging AI claims by the comparisons, uncertainty analysis, and reproducible evidence that support them.
description: We develop principles for judging AI claims by the comparisons, uncertainty analysis, and reproducible evidence that support them.

title: Industrial AI & Decision-Making
question: How can machine learning, optimization, and simulation support operating decisions in industrial systems?
summary: We use machine learning, optimization, and simulation to support design and operational decisions in manufacturing, logistics, and service systems.
